question: Related Questions Q. Loans 1790 views Q. Teaching finance education to students 7994 views Q. Can I purchase vehicle or any product in EMI? 17345 views Q. Every year we give gifts to all society members in the form of eatables etc. This year we decided to gift dry fruits. All the managing committee members went to the market to purchase the dry fruits for and on behalf of all the society members. After purchasing the dry fruits one of the managing committe members requested for some personal gift from the shop keeper. As the purchase was a huge amount, the shopkeeper gifted all the managing committee members some chocolates which they kept for personal use. I did not object at that time, but later decided that i would give the gift away in sadkah from the society's side and requested the other members to do the same. They all refused to give the choclates away. I told them three times but they still kept for personal use. Please tell me: Is keeping the gift allowed, when we went to purchase material for the society? How can we take personal favors from the shopkeeper? 2. Is giving it away in sadkah correct? answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 43801 Country: India Title: Producing fake HRA to avoid Government Tax Question: I work in IT Sector and around Rs 7200 is deducted from my salary annually and for escaping from tax I have done life insurance so now after doing life insurance only 3600 is deducted annually I can escape the other 3600 if I show HRA to my company but I live in my parent's home so I don't pay rent to my parent but I give some part of salary to my parents. So my question is doing insurance for escaping from Tax is right or wrong and is Shariah allows me to show HRA to company in this particular case for escaping from tax. Answer ID: 43801 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 216/180/H=1434) It is unlawful to produce HRA fraudulently, it is sinful. If you are living in your parents’ house, there is no issue if you have dealing of rent with your parents in clear terms, and then you get tax exception on HRA basis. It is allowable for you to have rental dealing with your parents. (N) It is also lawful to resort to life insurance in order to avert taxation, but one will have to give the additional amount in charity to the poor without an intention of reward. It should not be used in personal needs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
